slides.text: 5 things nobody tells you in your first job
Your manager will not hand you a roadmap. Ask specific questions, not "what should I do?"
Keep a weekly note of what you finished. At appraisal time, memory alone will not help you.
Learn how decisions get made in your team, not just how tasks get done.
Being useful beats being right. Help the team first. Credit usually follows.
Your first salary is a starting point, not a verdict. Skills compound faster than raises.
Find one person who is 3 years ahead of you and watch how they work.
Save this for your first week. Send it to a friend who is joining soon.
slides.sub: Follow for one career rule a day

caption:
First job nerves are normal. These five habits make the first year easier.
